steps.description: Mark the beds. (1) tomato bed: Tomato on 3 ft centers, basil and marigold between.
plantVarieties: 'Sungold' or 'Juliet' tomato (a cherry and a paste type together)
steps.wateringNeeds: Deep soak twice a week; keep leaves dry to slow blight.

steps.description: Sheet-mulch the paths and any new ground this fall — cardboard, then compost, then whatever the town will give you. Skip the tiller; the worms do the work.
One soaker line down the middle of the tomato bed. Deep and infrequent beats a daily sprinkle. Water at the base, deeply, once or twice a week.
steps.wateringNeeds: Water at the base, deeply, once or twice a week.

steps.description: Cold frame at the west end for the kale — hinge it south, reuse a storm window. Planted in October, harvested the following July — the one crop you plant for next year.
steps.wateringNeeds: Steady moisture; tolerates less than most brassicas.

steps.description: Sow the bush bean every 14 days from a week after last frost — that 14-day stagger is what keeps August from becoming one impossible week.
steps.wateringNeeds: Even moisture while flowering and podding; drought = stringy pods.
